composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, the diorama centered and filling about 75% of the frame with even margins (at least 12% on every side). It is a small compact diorama group — one little table with two chairs — not a room interior: no walls, no ceiling, no floor plane. The sheet of paper on the table is completely BLANK: plain pale cream paper, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no ruled lines. No table-cloth, no shadow plate: the diorama floats on a fully transparent background (PNG alpha). Soft warm daylight from the upper-left, soft short shadows only within the objects. Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, warm and calm, bright but not neon.
forbidden_objects: writing or marks on the paper
attribute marks, icons, badges or symbols
walls, ceiling, windows or a room interior
cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the diorama
background: fully transparent (PNG alpha). If a transparent background is impossible, use a single flat pure white #FFFFFF backdrop with NO gradient and NO shadow outside the diorama.
purpose: こんだてPLAY の「相談する場所」を表す小さな家具ジオラマの master asset（純粋な visual）。人物・部屋・床・背景は仕様として意図的に描かない — 登場人物も文字も UI 層が上に重ねるので、この画像は透過背景に浮く家具だけで正しい。空であること・人がいないことは欠陥ではなく要件
scene: a miniature quiet corner diorama with no people in it: one small round warm wooden table with two small wooden chairs facing each other across it, and a single sheet of blank pale cream paper lying flat on the table top. Calm, warm and simple, nothing else on the table. Same matte clay / miniature toy material, same lighting and same warm palette as the school building and the cream lunch tray. Series: JIBUN CHOICE 給食 こんだてPLAY, same camera, lighting and clay material as the dish set.
required_objects: one blank sheet of paper on the table
